units.source_text: 源氏公子道：“有高手在此，我弹得真是所谓‘闻琴不知是琴声’，惭愧死了！”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "With such a master here, my playing is truly what they call 'hearing the koto without knowing it is the sound of a koto.' I am ashamed to death!"

units.source_text: 他把筝推开，又说：“奇怪得很：

en.t: He pushed the zheng aside and said again, "It is very strange:

units.source_text: 筝这个东西，从古以来女子弹得最好。

en.t: As for the zheng, from ancient times women have played it best.

units.source_text: 嵯峨天皇的第五位公主，受天皇嫡传，是世间最高明的弹筝家。

en.t: Emperor Saga's fifth princess received the art directly from the emperor and was the finest zheng player in the world.
After that, this lineage was lost.

units.source_text: 今世号称专家的人，都只是皮毛功夫而已。

en.t: Those in our time who call themselves experts have only a superficial skill.

units.source_text: 这浦上却隐藏着此道的能手，真是意想不到的快事！

en.t: Yet here on this shore there is a hidden master of the art; what an unexpectedly delightful thing!

units.source_text: 但不知可否让我听一听令嫒的妙技？”

en.t: But might I possibly be allowed to hear a little of your daughter's marvelous skill?"
